notes.title: The Music & Audio Update is here!
notes.content:
This update of Sisterly Lust has been in the works for quite a while now and I'm happy to be able to release for you all it today.

[h3]Music & Audio[/h3]
One of the most requested features in the game has been music and audio. The latest update of the game introduces music composed specifically for the game by a composer who wishes to remain anonymous.

In addition to music, ambient sound effects have been added throughout the game as well. Sex scenes have been upgraded with lewd effects (with the help of the amazing [url=https://opennsfw.carrd.co/]OpenNSFW Sound Pack[/url]) and voice acting by the inimitable [url=https://www.voicelikecandy.com/]VoiceLikeCandy[/url].

[h3]Lovense[/h3]
Sisterly Lust also features Lovense integration. So if you have a device, you can link it up with the game and get yourself stimulated with tailored patterns for your toy of choice. Read more about it [url=https://www.lovense.com/game/sisterly-lust]here[/url]. 

I have good news for you if you don't own a Lovense device, or if you're in the market for another toy. To celebrate the launch of this update, I've partnered up with Lovense and we're able to offer you a whopping 55% discount on any purchase made using [url=https://www.lovense.com/a/PerverteerGames]this affiliate link[/url].

[h3]Scene Gallery[/h3]
Sisterly Lust has lacked a scene gallery since its release and this update now includes one, as the code got an overhaul due to the inclusion of music and audio. You'll now be able to replay sex scenes you've encountered in your playthroughs and also be able to experience the variations of various scenes in case you've missed a narrative path.

[h3]Localization[/h3]
Many of you have also requested a Chinese translation of the game and I have good news on that front as well. The new update also includes a Simplified Chinese translation by kittyr119!

Additional changes can be found in the changelog below.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
- Update to Ren'Py 8.3.3
- Add music and sound effects (thanks to VoiceLikeCandy and OpenNSFW)
- Add scene gallery
- Add achievements to non-Steam builds
- Update loading and splash screens
- Fix spelling and grammar (thanks to Grubb, Randall and Fhilb)
- Add Lovense support
- Add Turkish (thanks to `SpeciaL.)
- Add Simplified Chinese (thanks to kittyr119)
- Day 34: Fix image size
- Day 12: Replace Rachel's donkey O-face

notes.title: Sisterly Lust v1.1.10 (Bugfix)
notes.content:
Even though the changelog might seem a little short, this bugfix release has been in the works for some time. This update introduces a Brazilian Portuguese translation courtesy of Grubb, who in the process of translating found a great many inconsistencies and spelling/grammatical errors. All of these should be fixed.

Randall has proven himself to be an expert on almost any path in Sisterly Lust and as a consequence found a few game-breaking issues in the less-played paths. Those errors should be fixed as well. It's now also less easy to miss the early triggers for Bella's and Rachel's relationship on Day 4, thanks to SGD.

The game has also been updated to the latest version of the game's engine, which should hopefully offer better Steam Deck support.

The game is now also available for macOS, but please not that the builds are not notarized, so GateKeeper will probably complain when running the game for the first time.

notes.title: Verified for Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Valve has officially verified Sisterly Lust for Steam Deck!

The latest update of the game offers better Steam Deck support. Unfortunately keyboard input is a little finicky in the game's engine, so I had to disable save game naming. Naming the MC and his mother and sisters is still possible on the Steam Deck.

[b]Changelog[/b]

- Better save game naming on Steam Deck
